#DataScience #Fintech #Python #SQL #TimeSeries #ScikitLearn #ApacheAirflow  

I’m Ryan Gallagher, a Senior Data Scientist at FinTech Innovators Inc. Over the past four years, I’ve focused on turning complex financial data into actionable insights—mostly through Python, SQL, and a healthy dose of curiosity. My work leans into NumPy for optimizing algorithmic performance, Pandas for cleaning and transforming messy datasets, and scikit-learn for building models that predict market trends.  

One project I’m proud of involved using time series analysis to detect fraudulent transactions. By combining historical data with statistical models, we cut false positives by 25% while improving detection accuracy. Another highlight? Scaling SQL queries to handle 10x more data volume, which slashed report generation time by 40%.  

Apache Airflow has been a go-to for orchestrating data pipelines, especially when integrating real-time analytics with batch processes. It’s helped keep our workflows reliable, even during peak trading hours.  

Outside the code, I’m always looking for ways to simplify complex problems—whether it’s refining a model’s logic or streamlining a data pipeline. Fintech’s fast-paced and ever-changing, so adaptability is key. Let’s connect if you’re curious about how data can drive smarter decisions in finance.
